7.8.4.3 LINTP_E_LINTPNCR_TIMEOUT_OCCURRED
[SWS_LinIf_00883] ⌈ Error Name: LINTP_E_LINTPNCR_TIMEOUT_OCCURRED Short Description: A N_Cr timeout is detected Long Description: LinIf (LinTp part) shall report a LINTP_E_LINTPNCR_ TIMEOUT_OCCURRED Extended Production Error to DEM when a N_Cr timeout is detected. Fail N_Cr timer expired Detection Criteria: Pass LinTp_Init() function call Secondary Parameters: The condition under which the FAIL and/or PASS detection is active: None Time Required: Not applicable Monitor Frequency: on event
⌋
